Great campaign stops in Quincy, Marianna, and Blountstown today — and I’ll be at the Gulf Coast Jam tonight.

Join us next Friday, June 5th, in Kissimmee.

Prioritizing success pathways in education will unlock the full potential of the Florida Dream.

Video

Gadsden Tomato Company in Quincy, FL has been packaging delicious Florida tomatoes since 1982. It was a pleasure to tour their facilities with @erikadonalds today. 

The Florida tomato industry generates about $330 million a year — just one example of our state’s incredible agricultural production. 

As Governor, I will always fight for our farmers and agricultural community!

Yesterday I had the privilege of touring the floor at GMF Steel Group in Lakeland.

These folks take tremendous pride in their product — and this company provides outstanding, skilled manufacturing jobs.

These are the kind of jobs I’ll create more of as Governor.

Watch the full remarks below: my education proposal for personalized success plans for every Florida student;

Video

Great to be in Brandon this morning to roll out my education policy platform: personalized success plans for every student.

We will retool existing 6-12 grade requirements and give every student a living plan built with their parents.

There is no one-size-fits-all student — and there shouldn’t be one pathway to a career.

Affordability starts at home. 

Floridians shouldn't have to choose between protecting their home and paying their bills. 

That's why I'm fighting in Washington, DC to let middle-class families deduct flood insurance premiums from their taxes.

I sponsored the Financial Freedom Act in Congress because your retirement savings should work for YOU, not get caught up in Washington D.C. red tape.

Folks in Florida and across America deserve full control over their own financial futures.

Love getting to meet the next generation of Floridians.

I launched my career, started a family, and built my life on the Florida Dream.

Now I'm fighting to make sure they can do the same.

Video

I’m fighting to make sure that Florida's waters aren't micromanaged by Washington, D.C.

My Restore Florida Water Independence Act will protect the wetlands and Everglades while putting permitting authority back where it belongs -- the Sunshine State.


Congressman Byron Donalds (@RepDonaldsPress)

In 2024, the State of Florida was stripped of its authority over Section 404 Clean Water Act wetland permits by the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia.

I support what the Governor wants to accomplish. 

I look forward to the Governor and legislature working together to provide real relief for the people of Florida.


Spectrum Bay News 9 (@BN9)

During a conference in Tampa on Wednesday, Gov. Ron DeSantis said that he wanted to eliminate some property taxes for homesteaded primary residences and stated his support for taxpayers.

There’s a reason that so many America First organizations give me a perfect rating. I’m proud to have one of the most conservative records in the country — and as Governor, I will fight to defend the Florida Dream

A very special Memorial Day. Spent yesterday morning meeting amazing Florida veterans at the City of Jacksonville’s Memorial Day event before visiting the River Fest in Clay County.

This state is full of incredible Patriots honoring those who gave the ultimate sacrifice for our nation. Proud to be a Floridian and proud to be an American.

Texas, today is the day to get out and VOTE for @chiproytx to be your next Attorney General. I have served with Chip, and it's beyond any doubt that he is the true Conservative who will always fight for you and America! Texas, Vote Chip Roy for AG!

Video

“Greater love has no one than this.”

Those are the words of our Savior, and generations of Americans have lived them out in blood and sacrifice on battlefields a world away from home.

Today is a remembrance. It is a reckoning with the truth that every freedom we cherish, every right we hold, and every quiet morning with the people we love, was paid for by men and women who never came home.
